note: v1885: The vault sweep had no name fold at all while the chronicle sweep has had one for versions, and merge-max never subtracts, so a misread became a permanent row. Pushing the exact corrections his chronicle sweep made yesterday at the vault instead gave six owned rows for three real items. Now an exact fold, and only exact: the apostrophe class is corrected and near matches are refused, because my own fold near-matched a set aggregate onto one of its pieces within a minute of being written, which is a find he never made. A chronicle page is a closed list of grail names; a stash is an open universe.
